verdict.rationale: Loops documents programmatic contact create/update endpoints. Its MCP server and CLI can "manage contacts and mailing lists," so list membership can be changed from code. Segments, however, appear only as dynamic dashboard objects, and nothing shows an API to create or edit segments or tags, or to list exactly which contacts belong to a list or segment. Missing for 10: API endpoints to create/update segments or tags, an endpoint to read back list/segment membership, detailed docs on mailing-list API operations, and hands-on corroboration.
